title: Prescription draft
description: Write the medicines you would prescribe for this completed visit, using fixed templates.
synthetic: Synthetic data for testing only. Never enter real patient information.
gated: Prescription drafts are switched off until clinical features are approved and enabled. Nothing here is saved or shown.

notIssued.title: Draft - not issued
notIssued.body: Issuing prescriptions is not available. This draft is not sent to the patient or to any pharmacy, and it is not a valid prescription.

notCompleted.title: Prescription drafts open after the visit is completed
notCompleted.body: You can draft a prescription once this booking is marked completed.

editor.title: Medicines
editor.intro: Type each medicine name yourself; there is no drug list or suggestion. Choose form, schedule and instruction from the templates. Nothing is saved automatically.
editor.max: A draft can hold up to {max} medicines.

item.medicineNameHint: As you would write it. No lookup is done.

errors.strength: Strength of medicine {n} must be 40 characters or fewer.
errors.duration: Enter the number of days for medicine {n}, from 1 to {max}.
errors.noItems: Add at least one medicine before saving.

conflict.title: This draft changed somewhere else
conflict.body: A newer version was saved or the draft was discarded. Reload to see the latest; your unsaved changes here will be lost.

discard.title: Discard this prescription draft?
discard.body: The saved draft is deleted. This cannot be undone.

preview.title: Saved draft
preview.notIssued: Draft - not issued. Not a valid prescription.
